title_en: In the Courtroom (19/20): Mediating a Labor Dispute
note_en: 即使…也… means "even if ..., still ...": 即使公司遇到困难，也应该按时发放员工的基本工资 "even if a company runs into difficulties, it still has to pay basic wages on time." Unlike 如果 "if," 即使 grants the condition and says it changes nothing. The 也 in the second clause is required and does the work of English "still."
